patterns: Rankings beat the headline: 13 Hunger Games posts drew 4,794,175 views (34% of hit views). FilmUpdates' franchise opening-weekend ranking (1,314,042) did 3.6x its own straight '$120M opening' post (365,265), and DiscussingFilm's version with the 'second-biggest prequel opening' context did 741,999.

Hype with no footage, again: 5 Avengers: Doomsday posts drew 3,329,309 views (24%) before the new trailer was out. A casting confirm (Hailee Steinfeld back as Kate Bishop, 1,474,685) and a music-cue tease (the countdown playing Steve & Peggy's theme, 1,083,360) led, ahead of the runtime news (561,501).

GTA 6 is still spilling into film feeds: 3 posts drew 2,020,714 (14%). The two DiscussingFilm posts that worked were a human story (a developer's in-game tribute to his late mother, 723,599) and a blunt quality quote from Rockstar (1,256,730).

Strong opinion quotes travel: Rockstar's 'better not to do it than do it badly' (1,256,730), Francis Lawrence on a franchise 'people aren't embarrassed by' (334,106) and Villeneuve calling Dune: Part Three the best of his trilogy (172,785) all beat plain announcements from the same accounts.

Small accounts ran on feelings and one-liners: All The Right Movies' best was an archive clip of McConaughey remembering Sam Shepard (176,585, 4x its next post), and its one-line questions (Ruffalo, Scarlett Johansson, Leon rate-it) each cleared 17K. Cinema Tweets' short slogan captions ('Movies Are Moments', 46,696) beat its long reviews (21,143 best). Rotten Tomatoes' best was a cast role-swap game (88,142).
narrative_synthesis: Monday after Sunrise on the Reaping's big weekend: ranking-style box office posts beat the headline number, and Avengers: Doomsday hype (Kate Bishop confirmed, runtime, countdown music) peaked hours before the new trailer. GTA 6 is still drawing film-feed views. Doomsday's branching-timelines hook is the best way into AI Aftermaths.
window: last 24h (Nov 22 8:25 AM – Nov 23 8:25 AM ET), original posts only
